item.title: Lithium-ion battery fire triggers SDSU dorm evacuation, one student injured
item.description: A lithium-ion battery fire in a San Diego State University dorm room caused a late-night evacuation and left one student with minor injuries.

item.title: Last 2 names of 6 US soldiers who died in Kuwait attack identified by the Pentagon
item.description: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa (AP) — The last two names of the six U.S. soldiers killed in a drone strike at a command center in Kuwait were released Wednesday by the Pentagon, and they are from California and Iowa. item.title: Westfield UTC mall in San Diego reduces free parking time
item.description: Westfield UTC in La Jolla has reduced the free parking limit from two hours to one hour, with a $2 charge for each additional hour.

item.title: Iconic LDS Church temple in San Diego offering once-in-a-generation public access
item.description: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints has announced open house dates for its San Diego Temple.

item.title: Man found dead in parked car in San Diego
item.description: The San Diego Police Department is investigating the death of a man who was found deceased in a parked car in the Morena neighborhood.

item.title: Jackson Merrill with Grogu: Exclusive Padres bobbleheads available at Petco Park in 2026
item.description: The San Diego Padres have unveiled a list of exclusive Theme Game items available to fans at Petco Park in 2026, including one-of-a-kind bobbleheads, such as a Jackson Merrill Mandalorian and Grogu bobblehead, and other unique items.

item.title: Cyclist embarks on cross-country journey from San Diego to Florida to honor organ donors
item.description: Ken Abbot is embarking on a cross-country cycling journey to raise awareness and funds for organ donation, in honor of his own heart transplant and the generosity of his donor.

item.title: Increase in Jeep thefts throughout San Diego County
item.description: Jeep Wranglers are one of the most sought-after cars for buyers, but also for thieves, who target them for their parts and off-road capabilities, and a simple steering wheel lock can help prevent theft.

item.title: Unseasonably warm weather brings spike in rattlesnake sightings
item.description: Rattlesnake sightings have increased in San Diego County due to unseasonably warm and dry winter temperatures, with The Snake Wranglers receiving 43 calls in February, up from 18 last year.

item.title: Semi truck overturns on I-15 southbound, causing traffic delays
item.description: A semi truck flipped on the I-15 southbound in Mission Valley, causing heavy traffic and congestion.
